---
title: "scRNA-seq PBS vs AEC: myeloid cells"
author: "Yuxi"
date: "2022-11-24"
output: html_document
editor_options: 
  chunk_output_type: inline
---

Single cell RNA-seq of one PBS-treated and one AEC-treated mouse. Ambient RNA was removed with CellBender.
This script was written for Seurat v4. To run it with Seurat v5, keep `options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")` in the setup chunk.

Subclustering of myeloid cells, gene panels, module scores, DEGs and enrichment between subclusters and conditions, Mrc1+ cells.
Starts from the objects in `data/cell/` saved by `01_QC_integration_annotation.Rmd`. Gene panels: `data/gene_panels/`.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```


```{r load all the packages}
library(tidyverse)
library(Matrix)
library(Seurat)
options(Seurat.object.assay.version = "v3")

library(cowplot)
library(clustree)
library(niceRplots)
library(scCustomize)
library(harmony)
library(geomtextpath)
library(webr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(RColorBrewer)

#For preprocessing
library(DoubletFinder)

#For Cell interaction
library(CellChat)
library(liana)

#For enrichment Analysis
library(correlationAnalyzeR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(xlsx)
library(gprofiler2)
library(plotly)
library(DOSE)

#For transcriptional factor network
library(loomR)

#For Trajectory imputation
library(slingshot)
library(tradeSeq)
library(fields)
library(rafalib)

for (d in c("data/cell", "results/cell/Myeloid", "results/cell/Myeloid/Trajectory", "results/cell/Mast", "results/cell/Tcell", "results/cell/Bcell", "results/cell/DC", "results/cell/Neutrophil", "results/cell/Cellchat", "results/cell/LIANA", "results/cell/SCENIC")) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}
```


```{r Myeloid Cells}
DATA_Immune <- readRDS("data/cell/Cell_Immune.rds")
DATA_Immune <- SetIdent(DATA_Immune, value = "Celltypes")
DATA_Myeloid <- subset(DATA_Immune, idents = c("Myeloid Cell"))

DefaultAssay(DATA_Myeloid) <- "CCA"
DATA_Myeloid <- ScaleData(DATA_Myeloid, features = rownames(DATA_Myeloid))
DATA_Myeloid <- RunPCA(DATA_Myeloid, npcs = 30)
DATA_Myeloid <- RunUMAP(DATA_Myeloid, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_Myeloid, split.by = "Condition")

# Redo the clustering ----
DATA_Myeloid <- FindNeighbors(DATA_Myeloid, dims = 1:30, k.param = 15)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_Myeloid <- FindClusters(DATA_Myeloid, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_Myeloid@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.")

# Lets go for resolution 0.3----
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.3")
DATA_Myeloid$seurat_subclusters <- DATA_Myeloid$CCA_snn_res.0.3
plot_grid(DimPlot(DATA_Myeloid, group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.25", label = T),
          DimPlot(DATA_Myeloid, group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.3", label = T),
          FeaturePlot(DATA_Myeloid,c("Ptprc","P2ry12"))
          )

DimPlot(DATA_Myeloid, group.by = "CCA_snn_res.0.3", label = T)+ggtitle("Myeloid Cells Subtypes")

#Annotate the myeloid Cells roughly (resolution 0.25)----
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.25")
new.ids <- c("Mac-1",
             "Mac-2",
             "Mac-1",
             "Mac-2",
             "Prolif-Mac",
             "Mac-1",
             "Mac-2",
             "M2-Mac",
             "M2-Mac")
DefaultAssay(DATA_Myeloid) <- "RNA"
new.ids <- setNames(new.ids,as.character(0:(length(new.ids)-1) ))
DATA_Myeloid$Subtypes1 <- new.ids [ match( as.character(DATA_Myeloid$CCA_snn_res.0.25) , names(new.ids))  ]
DimPlot(DATA_Myeloid, group.by = "Subtypes1")

saveRDS(DATA_Myeloid, "data/cell/Cell_Myeloid2.rds")

#Proportions----
summarized.df <- DATA_Myeloid@meta.data %>%
  group_by(Condition, seurat_subclusters) %>%
  summarize(nCells = n()) %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = nCells/sum(nCells))

ggplot() +
  geom_bar(data = summarized.df, aes(Condition, prop, fill = seurat_subclusters), stat = "identity", color = "black") +
  theme_classic() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  coord_flip()

PieDonut(summarized.df, aes(Condition,seurat_subclusters, count = nCells),r0 = 0.3, ratioByGroup = T,showRatioThreshold = 0, labelpositionThreshold = 0.1)


#Gene panels from nanostring----
for (panel in c("metabolic pannel", "Neuroinflammation", "Innate Immunity")) {
a <- read.delim(paste0("data/gene_panels/", panel, ".txt"), header = F)
b <- as.vector(a$V1)%>% unique()
c <- intersect(rownames(DATA_Myeloid[["RNA"]]@data),b)
DATA_Myeloid2<- ScaleData(DATA_Myeloid, features = c)
ord_all <- factor(sapply(c,function(x){getcluster(DATA_Myeloid2, x, "seurat_subclusters")}))
d<-c[order(as.character(ord_all) )]
print(DoHeatmap(DATA_Myeloid2, group.by = "seurat_subclusters",features = d)+
 theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 2)) + ggtitle(panel))
}

#Difference between 7 and 8----
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "seurat_subclusters")
genes <- FindMarkers(DATA_Myeloid,
                     ident.1 = "7",
                     ident.2 = "8",
                     log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

genes<- genes[ genes$p_val < 0.05,  ]
genes$pct.diff <- genes$pct.1 - genes$pct.2
genes$log.pct.diff <- log2(genes$pct.1 / (genes$pct.2+0.01) )

plot_dots(DATA_Myeloid,genes = row.names( genes[genes$pct.diff>0.8,]), clustering = "seurat_subclusters")
VlnPlot(DATA_Myeloid, features = c("B2m","Cd68","Fth1","Ftl1","Ubb","Ccl5","Ccl3","Ptprc","Ifngr1","Fcer1g","Spp1","Gpnmb","Mrc1","Vim","Ly6a","Cd83","Clec7a"), pt.size = 0)
plot_dots(DATA_Myeloid, genes = c("B2m","Cd68","Fth1","Ftl1","Ubb","Ccl4","Ccl3","Mrc1","Ms4at","Ccr1","Dab2","Pf4","Stab1","Cbr2","Cd163","P2ry12","Tmem119"), clustering = "seurat_subclusters")


#DEGs for Clusters----
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "seurat_subclusters")
DefaultAssay(DATA_Myeloid) <-  "RNA"

detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_Myeloid, log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.3, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")
detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-10, p_val) %>% top_n(5, log.pct.diff) -> top5_all
detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all

plot_dots(DATA_Myeloid, genes = c( as.character(unique(top20_all$gene)),
                                   "Cd86","Cd36","Clec7a","Itgax","Adgre1","Itgam","Ptprc","Ly6c","Ly6g","Fmn1", "Mrc1","Tmem119","P2ry12","Cd80","B2m"
                                   ),main = "Myeloid Cells",assay = "RNA",clustering = "seurat_subclusters", pal = c("#cfc8d7","#a577f2", "#0434ff"))

write.csv(top20_all, file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_Markers_top20.csv")
write.csv(detable_all, file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_Markers_All.csv")
write.csv(top5_all, file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_Markers_top5.csv")

FeaturePlot(DATA_Myeloid, features = c("Ptprc","Mrc1","Lpl"), order = T) + NoAxes()

pdf("results/cell/Myeloid/Microglia_marker.pdf", width = 10,height = 7)
VlnPlot(DATA_Myeloid,features = c("P2ry12","Tmem119", "Hexb", "Cx3cr1","Fcrls","Sall1","C1qa","C1qb", "C1qc","Itgam","Siglech", "Gpr34",  "Ccr2","Ly6c1","Ly6c2","Mrc1","Arg1"),group.by="seurat_subclusters",pt.size = 0, stack = T, flip = T)
dev.off()

VlnPlot(DATA_Myeloid,features = c( "Alox15"),group.by="seurat_subclusters",pt.size = 0)

#GSEA Analysis on each clusters----
TERM2GENE <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "GO:BP", Species = "mmusculus")
KEGG <- getTERM2GENE(GSEA_Type = "KEGG", Species = "mmusculus")

for (i in 0:8) {
print(paste0("Cluster", i))
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene

geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =KEGG,
            pvalueCutoff = 0.1)

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_KEGG_Cluster",i), append = TRUE)
}

#DotPlot for GSEA----
geneList <- detable_all[detable_all$cluster == 2,]$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == 2,]$gene

geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE = KEGG,
            pvalueCutoff = 0.1,scoreType = "pos")

barplot.enrichResult(GOBP, color = "p.adjust", showCategory=c("KEGG_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", "KEGG_HUNTINGTONS_DISEASE", "KEGG_PARKINSONS_DISEASE", "KEGG_ALZHEIMERS_DISEASE")
, font.size = 10, title = "Myeloid_2 GSEA KEGG")

dotplot(GOBP, color = "p.adjust", showCategory=c("KEGG_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION", "KEGG_HUNTINGTONS_DISEASE", "KEGG_PARKINSONS_DISEASE", "KEGG_ALZHEIMERS_DISEASE")
, size = "GeneRatio", x="NES",font.size = 10, title = "Myeloid_2 GSEA KEGG"
        )

# Geneoncology on each clusters----
for(i in 0:8){
print(paste0("Current Cluster is ",i))
genelist=detable_all[detable_all$cluster == i,]$gene
go = gost(genelist, organism = 'mmusculus')

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(go$result[, c("term_name","p_value", "intersection_size", "term_size","term_id", "source")]), file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_GO.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GO_Cluster ",i), append = TRUE)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(gostplot(go,interactive = T)%>% layout(title = paste0("Cluster ", i))), paste0("results/cell/Myeloid/Cluster ",i," GO.html"))
}
```

#DEGs for Condition----
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "Condition")
DefaultAssay(DATA_Myeloid) <-  "RNA"

detable_all <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_Myeloid, log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")
detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

detable_all %>% group_by(cluster)  %>% top_n(-50, p_val) %>% top_n(20, log.pct.diff) -> top20_all

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(go$result[, c("term_name","p_value", "intersection_size", "term_size","term_id", "source")]), file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_GO.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GO_Condition ",i), append = TRUE)

htmlwidgets::saveWidget(as_widget(gostplot(go,interactive = T)%>% layout(title = paste0("Condition ", i))), paste0("results/cell/Myeloid/Condition ",i," GO.html"))

#split each cluster with Condition ----
DATA_Myeloid$Con_sub <- paste0(DATA_Myeloid$seurat_subclusters,"_",DATA_Myeloid$Condition)
DATA_Myeloid <- SetIdent(DATA_Myeloid, value = "Con_sub")
for (a in 0:8){
  print(paste0("Current Cluster is ", a))
  ident.1 = paste0(a ,"_PBS")
  ident.2 = paste0(a ,"_AEC")
  detable_all <- FindMarkers(DATA_Myeloid,
                             ident.1 = ident.1,
                             ident.2 = ident.2,
                             log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")
detable_all <- detable_all[ detable_all$p_val < 0.05,  ]
detable_all$pct.diff <- detable_all$pct.1 - detable_all$pct.2
detable_all$log.pct.diff <- log2(detable_all$pct.1 / (detable_all$pct.2+0.01) )

print(paste0("Current GSEA is for Cluster ", a))
geneList <- detable_all$avg_log2FC
names(geneList)=rownames(detable_all)

geneList=sort(geneList,decreasing = T)

GOBP <-GSEA(geneList, TERM2GENE =TERM2GENE,
            pvalueCutoff = 0.1)

write.xlsx(as.data.frame(GOBP@result), file = "results/cell/Myeloid/Myeloid_GSEA.xlsx", sheetName = paste0("GSEA_GOBP_",a), append = TRUE)
}

DATA_Mrc <- subset(DATA_Myeloid, idents = c("7","8"))
DefaultAssay(DATA_Mrc) <- "CCA"
DATA_Mrc <- ScaleData(DATA_Mrc, features = rownames(DATA_Mrc))
DATA_Mrc <- RunPCA(DATA_Mrc, npcs = 30)
DATA_Mrc <- RunUMAP(DATA_Mrc, dims = 1:30)

DimPlot(DATA_Mrc, group.by = "Condition")
DATA_Mrc <- FindNeighbors(DATA_Mrc, dims = 1:30, k.param =7)

for (res in c(0.1, 0.15,0.16,0.17,0.18,0.2,0.25,0.3,0.35,0.4,0.45, 0.5,0.55,0.6,0.65,0.75, 1,1.25, 1.5,1.75, 2,2.25, 2.5,3)) {
  print(paste0("current res", res))
    DATA_Mrc <- FindClusters(DATA_Mrc, graph.name = "CCA_snn", resolution = res, algorithm = 1)
}

clustree(DATA_Mrc@meta.data, prefix = "CCA_snn_res.")
DATA_Mrc <- SetIdent(DATA_Mrc, value = "CCA_snn_res.0.1")
DATA_Mrc$seurat_subclusters <- DATA_Mrc$CCA_snn_res.0.1
DimPlot(DATA_Mrc,label = T)
DefaultAssay(DATA_Mrc) <- "RNA"
genes <- FindAllMarkers(DATA_Mrc,
                     log2FC.threshold = 0.2,
    min.pct = 0.1, min.diff.pct = 0.2, only.pos = TRUE, max.cells.per.ident = Inf,
    assay = "RNA")

genes<- genes[ genes$p_val < 0.05,  ]
genes$pct.diff <- genes$pct.1 - genes$pct.2
genes$log.pct.diff <- log2(genes$pct.1 / (genes$pct.2+0.01) )

plot_dots(DATA_Mrc,genes = unique(genes$gene[genes$pct.diff>0.8]), clustering = "seurat_subclusters")
